The '''Dark Lands''' was the informal name for one of the districts of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], located in the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Nar Shaddaa's Undercity|Undercity]]. The Dark Lands were located directly beneath the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]], and were notable for having no electricity. Most of the paths to the district were blocked off, as the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] did not want the Dark Lands' criminals to interfere with the business taking place in the Red Light Sector.<ref name="LoNH" />
